findings.location: Poem, line beginning “A life on the run”
findings.source_quote: A life on the run, was not my desire.
findings.suggested_fix: لم تكن حياةُ الهرب ما أرغب فيه.

findings.location: Poem, line beginning “Let’s not give in”
findings.source_quote: Let’s not give in, there’s too much at stake.
findings.translation_quote: لا نستسلم؛ فالم stakes كثيرة جدًا.
